|Dimension={{L|Namek}}

|Inhabitants={{L|Namekian Trader}}, {{L|Namekian Warrior}}, {{L|Capsule Corp Namekian}}

<translate>
'''Namekian villages''' are the settlements of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian|Namekians]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. They come in two styles: '''Ajissa villages''' in the Ajissa Plains and '''Sacred villages''' in the Sacred Land. Their traders sell the map to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]], and their warriors hold off the Gete Robots that march on them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]]''' sell general goods. Every trader also sells a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for 16 Emeralds (4 uses).
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]]''' don't trade: they guard the village, and a few more keep spawning inside its walls.
* The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]]''' has its own house inside Ajissa villages and sells treasure maps to [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Gete Robot attacks ==
</translate>
<translate>
Robots from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] march on the Namekian villages. While you are near a village, small waves of 1–2 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]] can appear outside it every so often (up to 3 per village) and walk toward its centre, fighting the Namekian Warriors on the way.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding one ==
</translate>
<translate>
Players with the locate permission can find the nearest village with {{Command|/dmzlocate village_ajissa}} or {{Command|/dmzlocate village_sacred}} on Namek.
</translate>
